meta.name: lean-startup
meta.description: Design MVPs, validated learning experiments, and pivot-or-persevere decisions using Build-Measure-Learn. Use when the user mentions "MVP scope", "validated learning", "pivot or persevere", "vanity metrics", "test assumptions", "innovation accounting", "build-measure-learn", "minimum viable experiment", "should we pivot", "test a business idea cheaply", or "build the smallest version first". Also trigger when deciding what to include in a first version, measuring startup progress, or evaluating whether to change direction on a product bet. Covers innovation accounting and actionable metrics. For 5-day prototype testing, see design-sprint. For customer motivation analysis, see jobs-to-be-done.

copy.tagline: 用最小可行产品快速验证商业假设
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在用精益创业方法验证产品方向。
copy.tagline_en: Validate business hypotheses with minimum viable products
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are using lean startup methods to validate product direction.

howto.what: Claude 会引导你通过构建-测量-学习循环来设计最小可行产品（MVP）、验证学习实验以及转型或坚持决策。它会帮你识别最危险的假设、选择正确的指标，并决定是否改变方向。
howto.when: 当你提到“MVP范围”、“验证学习”、“转型或坚持”、“虚荣指标”、“测试假设”、“创新核算”、“构建-测量-学习”、“最小可行实验”、“应该转型吗”、“低成本测试商业想法”或“先构建最小版本”等关键词时触发。也适用于决定第一版包含什么、衡量创业进展或评估是否改变产品方向时。

say.text: 帮我设计一个MVP来测试我的新应用想法。
say.note: Claude 会引导你定义最危险的假设并选择最小测试方案。
Claude 会评估当前指标并给出转型或坚持的建议。

say.text: 如何用创新核算衡量我们的进展？
say.note: Claude 会帮你建立基线指标并设计实验来改进。
